target: NEG-HUNG-DRIVER actual psycopg projection transaction and runtime15s self-only watchdog.
method: Inject real SELECT pg_sleep(30) with SET LOCAL statement_timeout=30s after the real projection function returns within its still-open transaction. Observe exact PID/role/DB/query/open-xact independently before SIGTERM. Retain unchanged worker self-exit3 within12..18s. Observe actual backend disappearance by an absolute deadline40s after the recorded pre-query event, capped by the original215s body deadline; only then verify rollback and restart normal worker. No server disconnect setting, parent query cancellation or fabricated result.
agent: Code-dev owns amendment/integration; TC advised separately about server completion and fail-closed observation; complete independent source/ledger review pending.
pass_criteria: Actual native query/open transaction observed; exact owned worker self-terminates with3 and identity absent within12..18s, independent backend absence within absolute cap, DRAFT0/no receipt/no activity completion; recovery projects exactly once on the same admitted run. Parent termination/recovery never substitutes for child self-exit.

evidence: Private recorded query event time, exact pg_stat_activity observations, SIGTERM time, worker exit time, backend absence observation time, SQL/history before/after/recovery and source/environment pins. Public normalized counts/hashes only.

rationale.source_summary: Default interval0 disables checks during queries; disconnection can be detected at the next socket interaction. This supports avoiding an immediate-backend-death assumption; it does not prove actual test timing.
rationale.statement_bound: 30s remains inside approved full-plan pg_statement_seconds30 and exceeds runtime self-watchdog15s. Timeout or query completion happens in the still-open transaction; no connection context can commit after worker exit.
